text:
incident-bot: PAGER -> Reserved GPU pool 'resv-east-1' capacity breach. queue_length=142, tail_latency=1200ms, affected_tenants=[AcmeCorp, OrionAnalytics]. Paging SRE oncall now. :rotating_light:

oncall-alex: acked. I'm oncall. tagging infra and support.

eng-infra-lee: looking at autoscaler logs. seeing repeated scale attempts failing with provider quota errors. snippet:
```
autoscaler: attempt=8 target_replicas=12 provider_error=QuotaExceeded region=resv-east-1
```

sre-maya: noted noisy tenant signal for tenant=orion. high concurrent sessions with long-running streams. suggests preemptive eviction of non-critical sessions to free GPUs.

support-jordan: AcmeCorp reported 503s via support ticket #7891. I'm on customer bridge, they've got degraded throughput. Jordan -> bridge link: https://call/bridge/7891

eng-infra-lee: quick check -> provider quota for GPU-instances in region is at limit (max_instances=120). autoscaler currently blocked by provider-side quota error at the API layer. posting runbook step to try local mitigation first.

customer-liaison-sam: on AcmeCorp call, they're seeing model timeouts and failing webhooks. asking ETA.

oncall-alex: propose short-lived measures: 1) evict heavy sessions for tenant=orion, 2) route non-enterprise traffic to fallback smaller model, 3) request temporary burst increase from capacity team.

capacity-ops-bot: Capacity request created: CR-4729, requested +8 GPUs for 30m in resv-east-1. Pending approval from cloud quotas.

eng-infra-lee: running eviction dry-run:
```
/evict-tenant --tenant=orion --max-sessions=50 --dry-run
EvictPlan: sessions_marked=46 expected_gpu_free=3
```

sre-maya: go for it, evict live. prefer graceful drains first to avoid model corruption.

eng-infra-lee: executing eviction now:
```
/evict-tenant --tenant=orion --max-sessions=50 --grace=30s
Result: evicted=42 freed_gpus=3 pool_queue=now142->110
```

deploy-bot: Eviction workflow executed by eng-infra-lee in resv-east-1.

support-jordan: informing AcmeCorp: "we're routing some background jobs and doing session drains to restore throughput; we'll follow up with postmortem."

eng-infra-lee: autoscaler still trying to scale but failing on provider_quota. log:
```
autoscaler: attempt=9 error=QuotaExceeded remaining_quota=0
```

oncall-alex: capacity-ops, any ETA on quota bump?

capacity-ops-bot: Cloud provider reply: bump request accepted but will take ~18 minutes to provision new instances in resv-east-1. Alternative: we can allocate burst from spare pool in a different AZ and migrate instances (estimated 8-10 min) if you want faster relief.

sre-maya: migrate some reserved workloads to spare-az now, and route low-priority tenants to fallback-small. Lee, can you flip routing?

eng-infra-lee: flipping routing rules for non-enterprise traffic to fallback model (small-quant) now. command:
```
/routing update --pool=resv-east-1 --match=tenant!=AcmeCorp,tenant!=OrionAnalytics --route=fallback-small-quant
```
Result: ~30% of incoming RPS rerouted, pool_queue=110->62

oncall-alex: good. how's customer impact?

support-jordan: AcmeCorp still seeing some 503s but overall error rate improved from 12% -> 3% since routing and eviction. they're holding on the bridge.

customer-liaison-sam: logged customer-visible incident note, shared ETA and mitigation steps. Collecting contact for SOC postmortem.

eng-infra-lee: moved 4 reserved instances to spare AZ and migrated running jobs, freed additional GPUs. pool_queue=62->14, tail_latency=1200ms->220ms.

incident-bot: NOTE: autoscaler root cause: provider quota + rapid RPS spike from OrionAnalytics streaming workload. Action items created: ACT-114(eviction-run), ACT-115(routing-fallback), ACT-116(provider-quota-bump).

sre-maya: recommend throttling policy for heavy-tenants and a per-tenant soft concurrency cap to avoid eviction next time. filing RFC.

oncall-alex: monitoring. queue now 14, tail-latency 220ms. keeping pager open for 30m of stable metrics. big thanks to infra, support, and capacity ops. :tada:

support-jordan: closing customer bridge in 5m, will follow up with ticket updates and a summary for customer success.

customer-liaison-sam: capturing notes for postmortem and customer report.

oncall-alex: closing log: mitigation steps applied, customer impact reduced, provider quota increased (pending final confirmation). Will spin postmortem if metrics regress.

incident-bot: Pager resolved (auto) after 20m of restored metrics.
